purpose: Direct source audit for G3A [ENGINEERING] TensorBoard finalization; this evidence does not modify or backfill G2 events.

observed_facts.fact: RL-Games imports tensorboardX.SummaryWriter and constructs SummaryWriter(self.summaries_dir); nonzero rank has writer=None.
ContinuousA2CBase.train writes per-epoch scalars and returns (last_mean_rewards, epoch_num) at max-epoch/max-frame; no flush or close appears in this method.
Runner.run_train creates an agent, calls restore/sigma override, then agent.train(); it does not retain the agent or finalize writer.
Official Isaac Lab entry calls runner.run then env.close and simulation_app.close; it does not expose or finalize the RL-Games writer.
Population based training may wrap writer; __getattr__ delegates flush/close to underlying writer.

tensorboardx_runtime_observation.summary_writer_signature: (logdir=None, comment='', purge_step=None, max_queue=10, flush_secs=120, filename_suffix='', write_to_disk=True, log_dir=None, comet_config={'disabled': True}, **kwargs)
tensorboardx_runtime_observation.close_behavior: SummaryWriter.close() flushes each underlying writer before closing it.
tensorboardx_runtime_observation.interpretation: A missing final epoch is compatible with the default asynchronous flush interval and an exit path without explicit close, but this audit does not establish the historical G2 process exit path.

engineering_change.scope: Wrap only Runner.run_train; capture the new agent writer and call flush then close in finally. PPO/task/reward/physics/config are untouched.
engineering_change.activation: Set FACTORY_G3A_FINALIZE_TENSORBOARD=1 for a G3A run; G2 runs did not set this flag and their event files are preserved.
engineering_change.finalizer_status_output: Optional FACTORY_G3A_FINALIZER_OUTPUT receives an atomically replaced JSON record with training_error and per-writer flush/close status.
